text:
Aisha: Short thread to finalize Optimize Advisor pilot lanes (batching/caching/quant + eval-trigger alerts). Need pilot acceptance, owners, and customer slices.

Ben: Runtime note: split pilots by workload (chat vs embeddings). Batching must not violate per-tenant concurrency limits. Canary plan: 1%->10%->50%->100%.

Chen: Eval thresholds draft: min_samples=500, lookback=14d. Metrics: app_quality_drop <= 0.01, token_savings >= 0.15. Triggers should auto-alert product and optionally auto-rollback if drop>0.02.

Diego: Ops: Pilot on Dedicated only + optional Private customer. Need per-tenant kill-switch and rollback runbook. Caching recs must include TTL + eviction priority.

Elena: Customers want preview UI + short explainability snippet (reason + estimate). Also per-tenant opt-out and audit logs. I'll propose 3 pilot candidates.

Frank: Prioritization: score = 0.35*savings + 0.35*risk + 0.2*feasibility + 0.1*strategic. Use to pick two pilots (chat, embed).

Aisha: Owners: Ben(runtime), Chen(eval), Diego(ops), Elena(customers), Frank(prio). Next: Ben+Chen draft pilot plan by Wed EOD, Elena confirm pilots by Thu. Meeting Fri 10am to lock. :thumbsup:
